item.title: CVE-2026-128117: SvelteKit: adapter-node crashes with an unhandled URIError when `reroute` rewrites malformed pathnames
item.description: Severity: medium. When `reroute` turned an invalid percent-encoded path into a valid path, it could potentially trigger a comparison that would crash the server.

item.title: CVE-2026-128121: SvelteKit: Prerendered paths are interpreted as regular expressions in Vercel route config generated by @sveltejs/adapter-vercel and @sveltejs/adapter-static
item.description: Severity: medium. If an attacker could influence a link that was crawled during the prerender phase, that link could later be interpreted as a regex in the Vercel routing configuration.

item.title: CVE-2026-128122: SvelteKit: Prerendered redirect paths can inject arbitrary rules into the `_redirects` file generated by `@sveltejs/adapter-cloudflare`
item.description: Severity: medium. If an attacker can influence the links crawled during prerendering, they can influence the redirects entries that are added to the Cloudflare platform redirects generated during the adapt phase of the build.

item.title: CVE-2026-128123: SvelteKit: `@sveltejs/adapter-node` crashes when proxying certain requests via `fetch`
item.description: Severity: medium. In affected versions, `@sveltejs/adapter-node` can attempt to add a header to an immutable request in a context that causes the server to crash, denying service to any other requests routed to that server.
